title: $\tau$-Emotion-Bench: Exposing the Interaction Fragility of LLM Agents through Real-World User Emotions
abstract: arXiv:2610.19560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In long-horizon tool-calling tasks, LLM agents can fail not only because of tool-use errors, but also because of ineffective interaction with users. Yet existing benchmarks largely assume cooperative and behaviorally stable users, leaving the effect of emotional variation on agent reliability underexplored. We introduce $\tau$-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark for evaluating tool-calling agents under controlled emotion-conditioned user interactions while preserving the underlying task objective. To scale both benchmark construction and agent training, we introduce Tracer, a scalable agentic data-generation pipeline that constructs grounded, policy-valid tasks and collects trajectories through an interactive agent--user--environment harness. translated_title: τ-Emotion-Bench：通过真实世界用户情绪揭示大语言模型智能体的交互脆弱性
translated_abstract: 在长程工具调用任务中，LLM智能体的失败不仅可能源于工具使用错误，还可能源于与用户的低效交互。然而，现有基准大多假设用户是配合的且行为稳定的，导致情绪变化对智能体可靠性的影响研究不足。我们提出了τ-Emotion-Bench，这是一个涵盖十个领域的基准，用于在受控的情绪化用户交互条件下评估工具调用智能体，同时保持底层任务目标不变。为了同时扩展基准构建与智能体训练的规模，我们引入了Tracer——一个可扩展的智能体式数据生成流水线，能够构建有据可依、符合策略的任务，并通过交互式的“智能体-用户-环境”测试框架收集轨迹。通过允许不满意的用户终止低效交互，该测试框架提供了一种交互感知信号，用于过滤过度依赖用户的轨迹，并倾向于……
tldr: 提出τ-Emotion-Bench十领域基准和Tracer可扩展数据生成流水线，通过模拟真实用户的情绪化交互与终止低效对话的机制，评估并提升LLM工具调用智能体在面对情绪化用户时的交互可靠性。
en_tdlr: Introduces τ-Emotion-Bench, a ten-domain benchmark with a scalable Tracer data-generation pipeline that evaluates LLM tool-calling agents under emotion-conditioned user interactions, where letting dissatisfied users terminate inefficient interactions provides an interaction-aware signal for filtering trajectories.
